items.title: Tom Baker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: apparently Clifford Brown did everything without being a junkie or without drinking a whole lot

ctx.x: It’s as healthy as you want it to be. I think it was always healthy. There were guys that did it all without drugs, apparently Clifford Brown did everything without being a junkie or without drinking a whole lot. Other guys just got on the bandwagon and did it. And there are guys now that it’s not so much heroin going around, certainly not in our scene, there’s no junkies. There’s a lot of alcoholics, and a lot of guys that smoke too much. But basically it’s a healthy scene, yeah.
